title: Functional characterization of a maize UDP-glucosyltransferase involved in the biosynthesis of flavonoid 7-O-glucosides and di-O-glucosides.
authors: Petrich, Julieta; Alvarez, Clarisa Ester; Gomez Cano, Lina; Dewberry, Ronnie; Grotewold, Erich; Casati, Paula; Falcone Ferreyra, Maria Lorena
one_liner_zh: 该文研究玉米UDP-葡萄糖基转移酶在黄酮糖苷生物合成中的功能，虽涉及转录因子调控，但核心是酶学与代谢，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Flavonoids are glycosylated in the final steps of their synthesis by UDP-dependent glycosyltransferase enzymes. We present the functional characterization of the first maize flavonoid O-glucosyltransferase enzyme from family 85, which exhibits properties not previously described. ZmUGT85W2 catalyzes the O-glucosylation of flavonols, flavones and flavanones, to form primarily 7-O-glucosides, but also flavonol O-glucoside positional isomers, flavones and flavonol di-O-glucosides. ZmUGT85W2 exhibited a differential kinetic behavior depending on the flavonoid acceptor, showing hyperbolic dependence for flavonols and sigmoidal response for flavanones and flavones. Structural and molecular docking analyses predicted conserved residues interacting with the sugar donor, with close contact with the 7-hydroxyl of the flavonoid acceptors, consistent with enzymatic activity results. In addition, ZmUGT85W2 is induced by UV-B radiation, and its expression is controlled by the B and PL1 transcription factors. Consistently, higher levels of flavone and flavonol O-glycosides are accumulated in leaves of plants exposed to solar UV-B compared to control plants, suggesting that ZmUGT85W2 is involved in the biosynthesis of these metabolites in maize leaves, contributing to UV-B tolerance. The activity of ZmUGT85W2, along with its elevated expression in silks and pericarps expressing the R2R3-MYB transcription factor P1, highlights its critical role in the accumulation of flavonoid O-glucosides in these tissues. Together, our findings reveal a key step in maize flavonoid O-glycosides biosynthesis, with the observed positive cooperative behaviors suggesting that ZmUGT85W2 plays a crucial role in finely regulating metabolic flux towards these compounds in planta.
abstract_zh: 类黄酮在其合成最后步骤中由UDP依赖性糖基转移酶进行糖基化。我们展示了来自家族85的第一个玉米类黄酮O-葡萄糖基转移酶的功能表征，该酶表现出此前未描述的特性。ZmUGT85W2催化黄酮醇、黄酮和黄烷酮的O-葡萄糖基化，主要形成7-O-葡萄糖苷，但也形成黄酮醇O-葡萄糖苷位置异构体、黄酮和黄酮醇二-O-葡萄糖苷。ZmUGT85W2根据类黄酮受体的不同表现出差异性的动力学行为，对黄酮醇呈双曲线依赖性，对黄烷酮和黄酮呈S形响应。结构和分子对接分析预测了与糖供体相互作用的保守残基，并与类黄酮受体的7-羟基紧密接触，这与酶活性结果一致。此外，ZmUGT85W2受UV-B辐射诱导，其表达受B和PL1转录因子控制。一致地，暴露于太阳UV-B下的植物叶片中积累的黄酮和黄酮醇O-糖苷水平高于对照植物，表明ZmUGT85W2参与玉米叶片中这些代谢物的生物合成，有助于UV-B耐受性。ZmUGT85W2的活性，以及其在表达R2R3-MYB转录因子P1的花丝和果皮中的高表达，突显了其在这些组织中类黄酮O-葡萄糖苷积累中的关键作用。综合来看，我们的发现揭示了玉米类黄酮O-糖苷生物合成中的关键步骤，观察到的正协同行为表明ZmUGT85W2在植物体内精细调控这些化合物的代谢通量中发挥关键作用。
